body:
# Iran fires at Kuwait and Bahrain after the US Qeshm strike; ADNOC ship hit in Hormuz

**Sources read (pages opened, publication dates checked):** RTE News, 'Iran attacks Kuwait and Bahrain after US strike on Qeshm Island', published 2026-11-18 07:26Z, updated 10:46Z (Reuters copy). TIME, Chad de Guzman, 2026-11-18 10:15Z. Lane titles, not opened (WSJ 11:17Z 'Iran Attacks Kuwait and Bahrain, Further Escalating Fight Over Strait'; AP 12:44Z 'Iran widens Gulf attacks by targeting a US air base in Kuwait and sites in Bahrain'; Reuters 23:15Z Nov 17 'Iran fires at Kuwait after US strike on Iranian island'; SCMP 07:27Z; Bloomberg 07:40Z and 09:20Z). AP, Reuters and WSJ pages are not reachable by this desk's tools. **Date trap checked:** Iranian attacks on Ali Al Salem and Bahrain also ran in June and July 2026 and rank first in searches; both pages read are dated today and tie the attack to the Nov 17 Qeshm strike.

| Item | Words in the source | State |
|---|---|---|
| Kuwait | Kuwait's Armed Forces said early Wednesday its air defences were responding to 'hostile drone' attacks; the Iranian army said it targeted 'US drone and missile installations' at Ali Al Salem base (RTE/Reuters; TIME: 'Iran later took responsibility') | ATTACK CLAIMED by Iran; Kuwait reports interception activity; **no damage reported** |
| First since September | 'It was the first Iranian attack on the oil-rich country since September' (RTE/Reuters) | REPORTED (Reuters' count) |
| Bahrain | Bahrain 'intercepted Iranian aerial attacks for the third time this week'; accused Tehran of a 'systematic hostile approach' (RTE/Reuters). TIME: CENTCOM said the Nov 17 Iranian one-way drones at Bahrain 'were intercepted without any damage to U.S. equipment or injury to American personnel' | INTERCEPTED (not struck) |
| Riyadh | Saudi-led coalition says it destroyed a Houthi cruise missile launched toward Riyadh (RTE/Reuters) | INTERCEPTED |
| ADNOC ship | ADNOC said 11 crew injured and one missing after a ship belonging to the company was struck in the Strait of Hormuz 'yesterday' (Nov 17); UKMTO: tanker struck 'by an unknown projectile' about 13 nm north of Khasab (RTE/Reuters) | STRUCK, casualties per the operator; **vessel not named in the text read**; RTE's wording on the event day is ambiguous ('a day earlier') |
| Qeshm | US fighter jets fired on an IRGC missile launch site on Qeshm Nov 17, per an anonymous US military official (as card 028); Iranian media: no infrastructure damage | CONFIRMED by FALCON 11/17 (card 028) |
| Washington plot | Trump: US takes seriously a possible Iranian plot against Washington (CNN report citing intelligence, 'dirty bomb'); RTE/Reuters | REPORTED words; card 015 carried the plot title |
| Diplomacy | Talks via Oman and Qatar continue (TIME); Vance: Trump 'is not going to let this become a forever war' (Fox, Monday) | mediated, not bilateral |

**For FALCON:** the ADNOC hull needs the five ADD#26 discriminators (event day, vessel name, direction, mechanism, UKMTO position) before any census use; FALCON's 11/17 census holds TARA GAS (abandoned after a second attack), ON PHOENIX (probable) and AL DHANNAH (IMO list). 'Intercepted' is not 'struck' for Kuwait and Bahrain: no source read reports damage. Not an in-port hit (the anchor's Kuwait/Bahrain trigger is an EXECUTED in-port hit).

**Anchor:** WALTER's Iran anchor full sweep is due today (last 2026-11-11 13:55Z); this card is routed before that sweep: anchor_unverified_as_of 2026-11-11.

# New residential construction, October 2026 (Census, released 2026-11-18 08:30 ET)

**Source read:** census.gov/construction/nrc/current/index.html, fetched 2026-11-18 about 15:16Z (primary). FRED HOUST 1,309.0 and PERMIT 1,295.0 for 2026-10 agree.

| Series (SAAR) | October | September (revised) | Change | Year on year |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starts, total | 1,309,000 | 1,191,000 | +9.9% (±16.8%, not statistically significant) | +2.8% (±16.5%) vs 1,273,000 |
| Starts, single-family | 864,000 | 831,000 | +4.0% (±9.0%) | n/a |
| Starts, 5+ units | 433,000 | n/a in text read | n/a | n/a |
| Permits, total | 1,295,000 | 1,398,000 | -7.4% | -8.7% vs 1,418,000 |
| Permits, single-family | 772,000 | 846,000 | -8.7% | n/a |
| Permits, 5+ units | 475,000 | n/a | n/a | n/a |
| Completions, total | 1,272,000 | 1,194,000 | +6.5% (±13.2%) | -10.4% (±11.6%) vs 1,419,000 |

**What the reader should check (HOMER's call):** September starts are revised DOWN to 1,191,000 from the 1,221,000 HOMER carries, so the October jump is partly off a lower base. Of the +118,000 total move, single-family is +33,000; the rest sits in multifamily (HOMER's standing composition-mask check, KB-HOMER-013). Permits, the forward leg, fell 7.4%, single-family permits 8.7%: starts up, permits down. None of the starts changes is statistically significant at Census's 90% interval.

title: ECB Financial Stability Review, November 2026 (published Nov 18): 'risks from AI valuations, fiscal imbalances and geoeconomic tensions'; AI firms adding debt while 'circular financing is making intrinsic demand hard to gauge'; banks not materially exposed to an AI correction but could face spillovers via non-banks; floating-rate private credit passes higher rates straight to borrowers (ECB text read). FT title: AI borrowing has 'historic parallels' with subprime (the word subprime NOT found in the FSR web text read). Reuters exclusive (sources): ECB to discuss raising the reserve requirement next week. Vujcic: December hike 'very likely' (Bloomberg title)
body:
# ECB Financial Stability Review, November 2026, and two ECB policy items

**Source read:** ecb.europa.eu, FSR November 2026 HTML (ecb.fsr202611~e03b919d36), fetched 2026-11-18 about 15:20Z; the index page lists the next edition for 26 May 2027 and the annexes are dated 18 November 2026. Quotes below are from the ECB text.

| Point | ECB words (read) |
|---|---|
| Headline | 'Risks from AI valuations, fiscal imbalances and geoeconomic tensions cloud the financial stability outlook' |
| AI debt | AI-related firms 'are continuing to increase the volume of debt on their balance sheets, while circular financing is making intrinsic demand hard to gauge' |
| Banks | 'Even if banks are not exposed to a potential correction in AI-related assets in material terms, they could face spillovers via strong links with non-banks' |
| Private credit | higher yields raise debt service costs 'particularly for more leveraged segments of the AI ecosystem that rely on floating-rate or private credit financing'; 'the floating-rate structure of private credit means higher rates pass through immediately to these riskier borrowers' |
| Section 2.3 | 'AI external financing needs are increasingly linking exposures across different market segments' |
| Sovereigns | fiscal consolidation 'overdue'; 'news-sensitive, leveraged investors in sovereign bond markets' growing; Box 7 on hedge funds in euro area sovereign repo |
| Energy | 'energy supply disruptions could lead to rising credit risk'; Box 5 on oil supply shocks and bank asset quality |
| Other boxes | Box 6 bank reliance on credit-protection providers via synthetic risk transfers; special feature on AI and cyber threats |

**Not read, titles only:** FT 09:00Z 'AI borrowing binge has historic parallels with subprime bubble, says ECB' (the word 'subprime' does not appear in the FSR web text WALTER searched; it may come from a press briefing or an FT paraphrase). Reuters 12:42Z EXCLUSIVE 'ECB to discuss raising reserve requirement next week, sources say' (unnamed sources). Bloomberg 00:00Z 'ECB's Vujcic says December rate hike looks very likely'; TradingView 09:28Z 'Hedge funds helped fuel government bond selloff, ECB's Vujcic says'.

**Registered rows:** HANS-T-14 (b) needs an ECB or ESRB warning on bank-NBFI links that NAMES specific institutions; the FSR passages read name none (HANS judges, qualitative row). HANS-T-04 (ECB deposit rate) grades only on decision days; the December meeting is the next. A reserve-requirement rise is a funding-plumbing item for LIQUID and BOND.
source: ECB Financial Stability Review November 2026, https://www.ecb.europa.eu/press/financial-stability-publications/fsr/html/ecb.fsr202611~e03b919d36.en.html (read 2026-11-18 about 15:20Z); RESEARCH-INTAKE titles: FT 2026-11-18 09:00Z, Reuters 12:42Z, Bloomberg 00:00Z, TradingView 09:28Z
